methodology: Fresh independent canister per implementation/case/trial; identical Nat payloads and result checksums. Input setup and 4 explicit GC increments outside measurement. Raw performanceCounter(0) plus allocation/reclaimed deltas include loop/dispatch/counter overhead but exclude reply encoding and end-of-message GC. Core Queue 2.6.2 implements middle sequence lookup/page by cursor traversal. Wrapping Nat32 checksums prevent benchmark accumulation from allocating bigints at100k. Core.peekBack is O(1) when only the last entry is needed. Post-call memory sampled after 4 explicit GC increments; heap is current managed heap including uncollected partition garbage, memory is Wasm high-water, maxLive is historical post-GC heap high-water, neither is exact live retention. Exact retained chunk/slot/payload-byte counts come from benchmark-only representation inspection. Churn uses freshly allocated 1KiB Blobs in 64 batches of 1024, capacity1024, validates all retained bytes, forces 8 GC increments per checkpoint, then clears and repeats GC. Distinct allocation and retained heap are never conflated.
